title: 第1511章 俺怎么感觉你们都变厉害了封号再出来玩能一样第1510章 李靖跑路了质疑俺是同伙小玄仙能有先天灵宝
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 玉帝坐在龙椅上，听了李靖的话，心里笑了。
先天灵宝？
他自己当了这么久的玉帝，真正属于他的先天灵宝都没有几件。
西海龙王那家伙的儿子，撑死是个玄仙。
玄仙有多厉害？
天庭里随便抓个天将都是玄仙，金仙一抓一大把！
四大天王四个太乙金仙，加上李靖和十万天兵天将，被一条玄仙小龙给打退了？！！
开什么玩笑。
哪怕给那小龙一件极品先天灵宝，他也催动不了。
玄仙的法力就那么多，催动先天灵宝需要消耗的法力不是一个小数目，光是激活灵宝本身就需要相当于太乙金仙级别的法力输出。
撑死用出点威力。
那点威力能打退四大天王和十万天兵？
说出去谁信？
那小白龙背后肯定有人。
有人在暗中帮他，不然闹不到这个地步！
玉帝没有把这话说出来。
他端坐着，面色不变，目光扫过殿内众仙，沉吟了片刻，开口了。
“哪位仙家愿意主动下界，将那孽龙拿下？”
他顿了顿，又补了一句，道：“谁若是能将孽龙拿下，不但记功劳一件，孽龙手中的先天灵宝以及鹰愁涧内的一切战利品，全都归其所有。”
哗~
殿内一下子热闹了。
仙家们本来垂着眼睛，一副事不关己的模样。
听到先天灵宝四个字，一个个眼睛都亮了！
先天灵宝在洪荒中的数量不算多，每一件都是稀罕物。
一条玄仙小龙能靠一件灵宝做到这种地步，那珠子至少是中品先天灵宝，搞不好还是上品。
拿下小龙，灵宝就是自己的。
还有功劳，还有战利品，怎么算都是稳赚不赔的买卖！
“陛下！臣愿往！”
一个穿着赤红道袍的神仙从队列里走出来，朝玉帝拱手。
他身形高大，面容方正，眉毛浓黑，下巴上留着一撮短须。
腰间挂着一柄赤红色的长剑，剑鞘上刻着火焰纹路，离得近的仙家能感觉到一股热浪从剑鞘上散出来。
这是罗宣。
截教出身，封神之后归了天庭，被封为南方三气火德星君，统领火部。修为在准圣中期，算是天庭里排得上号的高手！
罗宣一出来，后面立刻有人不乐意了。
“罗宣，你一个玩火的要水的法宝做什么？”
说话的是个文官打扮的老者，头发花白，手里拿着一柄玉如意，看着罗宣的眼神带着不满道：“你火部的人，要一件水属性的先天灵宝，这不是占着茅坑不拉屎吗？把机会让给有用的人！”
旁边一个穿着黑色铠甲的武将也站了出来，声音粗犷：“是啊罗宣，你要那玩意做什么？火气太大了想要灭火？那珠子给你也是浪费！”
第三个神仙站出来。
是个穿着青袍的年轻仙人，面容俊朗，腰间别着一管洞箫，“罗星君，你火部的法宝已经够多了，这件水属性的灵宝，还是让给更需要的人吧，陛下说的是谁拿下归谁，又不是点名让你去。”
content_en:
The Jade Emperor sat on the dragon chair and smiled in his heart after listening to Li Jing's words.
Innate spiritual treasure?
He himself has been the Jade Emperor for so long, and he has very few innate spiritual treasures that truly belong to him.
The son of the Dragon King of the West Sea is a Xuanxian to death.
How powerful is Xuanxian?
Any general caught in heaven is a mysterious immortal, and a lot of golden immortals can be caught!
The four heavenly kings, the four Taiyi Golden Immortals, plus Li Jing and one hundred thousand heavenly soldiers and generals, were repelled by a mysterious dragon? ! !
What a joke.
Even if you give that little dragon a top-grade innate spiritual treasure, he can't activate it.
Xuanxian only has so much mana, and the amount of mana required to activate the innate spirit treasure is not a small amount. Just activating the spirit treasure itself requires a mana output equivalent to the level of Taiyi Golden Immortal.
Use some power to hold on until death.
That kind of power can defeat the four heavenly kings and one hundred thousand heavenly soldiers?
Who would believe it?
There must be someone behind that little white dragon.
Someone was secretly helping him, otherwise the trouble would not have reached this point!
The Jade Emperor did not say this.
He sat upright, his expression unchanged, his eyes swept over the immortals in the hall, he pondered for a moment, and then spoke.
"Which immortal family is willing to take the initiative to go down to the realm and capture that evil dragon?"
He paused and then added, "Whoever can capture Nielong will not only be credited with the credit, but also the innate spiritual treasure in Nielong's hands and all the trophies in Yingchou Stream will belong to him."
Wow~
The hall suddenly became lively.
The immortals had their eyes lowered, as if it had nothing to do with them.
When they heard the words "Xiantian Lingbao", everyone's eyes lit up!
The number of innate spiritual treasures in the ancient world was not large, and each one was a rarity.
A mysterious little dragon could achieve this with a single spiritual treasure. That bead was at least a middle-grade innate spiritual treasure, and it might even be a top-grade one.
If you capture the little dragon, the spirit treasure will be yours.
There are also credits and trophies. No matter how you calculate it, it is a sure-profit deal!
"Your Majesty! I am willing to go!"
A god wearing a red Taoist robe walked out of the queue and held his hands towards the Jade Emperor.
He is tall, square-faced, with thick black eyebrows and a short beard on his chin.
There was a red long sword hanging on his waist, and the scabbard was engraved with flame patterns. The immortal family who was close could feel a wave of heat emanating from the scabbard.
This is Luo Xuan.
He was born in Jiejiao and returned to heaven after becoming a god. He was named the Southern Three Qi Fire Virtue Star Lord and commanded the Fire Department. His cultivation is in the quasi-sage stage, and he is considered a top-ranked master in heaven!
As soon as Luo Xuan came out, someone behind him immediately became unhappy.
"Luo Xuan, why are you playing with fire and asking for water?"
The speaker was an old man dressed as a civil servant. He had gray hair and held a jade Ruyi in his hand. He looked at Luo Xuan with dissatisfaction in his eyes and said: "You, a member of the Ministry of Fire, want an innate spiritual treasure with water attributes. Isn't this just occupying a manhole and not shitting? Give the opportunity to useful people!"
A general wearing black armor also stood up next to him, with a rough voice: "Yes, Luo Xuan, what do you want with that thing? You are too angry and want to put out the fire? It would be a waste for you to give the beads!"
The third immortal stepped forward.
He was a young immortal wearing a green robe, with a handsome face and a flute on his waist. "Luo Xingjun, your Fire Department already has enough magic weapons. This water-attributed magic weapon should be given to someone who needs it more. Your Majesty said who should take it to whom, and he didn't ask you to go by name."
title_en: Chapter 1511 Why do I feel that you have become more powerful and you are banned and come out to play again? Chapter 1510 Li Jing ran away and questioned whether I was an accomplice and Xiao Xuanxian could have an innate spiritual treasure.
